approval.decision: Approvals: 2026-11-02 D01-D03; 2026-11-04 #82 D17-D24 and pointer dash; #79 dorm/camp return/airdrop/Boss/leader; 2026-11-05 #112 spray-guard D33, Boss patrol, camera 2250; 2026-11-07 movement -25%, flagpole 180s, guard 30s, airdrop 80s, loot -50%, vision/leash 1050, #147 build v7, #153 openings; 2026-11-08 #166 level 16/QWE, segmented growth, draft/quality and existing skill/attribute tuning; #97 camp growth stages, Elite camp tier, T2/T3 1.5x Boss 3x Equipment excluded; 2026-11-09 #144 equipment, gold and shops removed; 2026-11-10 #198 v0.11 workshop growth (stats/points/single-level actives) approved: 全部按当前规范批准，进入运行数据; #198 B base components B01-B18, level-up component category weights and empty-pool points from the same approval; #198 F mods M01-M12 and connectors C01-C12 from the same approval; #198 outer §5 field events (airdrop T=45..485 s, 40 s expiry, Boss T=240-540 s without approval buff, camp markers) approved: 批准整套方案，按票内参数实施. playtest input, not a balance test; #225: PK +50%, ceil and rotate.; 2026-11-13 Phase 4 workshop overhaul approved by user: brains AP 6/pt cap 300, mage/ranged active tuning, B04 own-share lifesteal, B13-B16 reworked as skill rules, new M13-M15 and C13-C16, host-legal level-up draws and category weights 45/30/25 35/35/30 25/35/40; 2026-11-15 Phase 5 skill-centric workshop approved by user: new bases B19-B21 (spell focus, low-HP escape, guard), mods M16-M20 (zone tether, shove, finisher, long empower, pull), connectors C17-C21 (zone relocate, stored force, empower spend, control widen, zone detonate); C02 hosts extended; #238 user approved four tiers, twelve species, HR x3 / trainer x2, fixed tier random species, 18/10/4/2 camps, and the proposed playtest combat/reward parameters: 采用这组试玩参数. Not balance acceptance.

display.description_text: 绑定强迫位移首次撞人时，另一名敌人受到魔法伤害并沿碰撞方向再次推移。原来源位移距离降低；二次推移不能再次触发本卡。分散站位或开阔路线可避免连撞。
display.effect_text: 绑定强迫位移首次撞人时，另一名敌人受到魔法伤害并沿碰撞方向再次推移。
display.notes_text: 二次推移不能再次触发本卡。分散站位或开阔路线可避免连撞。

display.description_text: 绑定来源在核心内成功硬控的敌人，实际控制结束后仍在核心则向外推移。原硬控时间降低，仍吃递减；提前离圈或位移免疫可反制。受控者仍争夺旗杆。
display.effect_text: 绑定来源在核心内成功硬控的敌人，实际控制结束后仍在核心则向外推移。
display.cost_text: 原硬控时间降低，仍吃递减。
display.notes_text: 提前离圈或位移免疫可反制。受控者仍争夺旗杆。

display.description_text: 绑定冲刺的实际路径留下禁行带，敌人进入或跨越时减速。该冲刺基础冷却增加；新带替换旧带，不伤害、不挡路。
display.effect_text: 绑定冲刺的实际路径留下禁行带，敌人进入或跨越时减速。
display.notes_text: 新带替换旧带，不伤害、不挡路。

display.description_text: 绑定放置区域的中心两侧生成两个更小的子区域，降低每跳基础伤害并缩短持续时间；元素和跳时保留。下一次施法同时替换旧两块；重叠可命中两次，中心覆盖较弱。
display.effect_text: 绑定放置区域的中心两侧生成两个更小的子区域。

display.description_text: 持有涂鸦期间，在核心成功普攻可在旗杆中心生成延迟魔法冲击。持旗期间普攻主击伤害降低；可躲冲击或先夺旗。冲击不复制普攻、施法、回响或控制。
display.effect_text: 持有涂鸦期间，在核心成功普攻可在旗杆中心生成延迟魔法冲击。

display.notes_text: 可躲冲击或先夺旗。冲击不复制普攻、施法、回响或控制。

display.effect_text: 离开核心连续一段时间后再入圈，下次成功普攻将目标沿远离旗杆方向推移。
